PRJ-02 Mobile application

Reading Habit Analytics

A mobile application for tracking reading progress, reading time, book collections, reading streaks, and reading statistics.

Home, analytics and goals

Links

GitHub repository

The problem

Readers who want a steady habit need a simple way to see how far they have read, how long they read, and how consistent they are. This app keeps progress, time, book collection, streaks, and statistics in one place.

The solution

A mobile application that records reading progress and reading time, keeps a book collection, tracks reading streaks, and presents reading statistics.

Implemented features

  • Reading progress
  • Reading time
  • Book collections
  • Reading streaks
  • Reading statistics

Technologies used

  • Flutter
  • Dart
  • Cloud Firestore
  • Firebase Authentication
  • Google Sign-In
